class_summaries.summary: HpxShortcuts is a page object class for Android Smart app that extends SmartFlow and provides comprehensive automation methods for managing HPX shortcuts functionality. It includes methods for verifying screen titles, clicking buttons and toggles, selecting options from dropdowns, entering text in fields, managing shortcut creation/editing/deletion, handling print/email/save destinations, configuring shortcut settings like color cards and file types, and verifying various UI elements and confirmation dialogs throughout the shortcuts workflow.
